title: Graduated Diamond Necklace
metaDescription: Graduated round brilliant diamonds — each transition invisible, each step reads as continuation. 18K gold. Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: A graduated diamond line requires every transition to be invisible — the eye should read a single increase in size and weight from the first stone to the last, not a sequence of visible steps. Each round brilliant was selected so the step from one stone to the next reads as continuation rather than increment. The engineering exists in service of the optical result.

specs.label: Gem Stone
specs.body: White diamond · Round brilliant — Natural. Graduated round brilliants from smallest accent to largest statement stone in a continuous line.
